expected.notes: Opposite corners of a 2x2 mesh: router-to-router Manhattan distance |1-0|+|1-0| = 2. A flit carries a 7-bit header (2-bit source, 2-bit destination, 2-bit flit_type, 1-bit vc_id) out of 64 bits, leaving 57 usable payload bits; 7 payload bytes = 56 bits fits in one flit. flits=1 is post-hoc (the payload was chosen after the header arithmetic was understood); packets/route_hops were written before execution. BookSim's reported hop average is the router-to-router count plus one because it counts the destination ejection.
